features.title: Optional attention alerts
features.surface: Extension toolbar and local center; basic OS notifications on Chrome/Firefox only
features.userOutcome: Enable bounded opt-in alerts for explicitly tracked verified transitions with quiet hours and deduplication.
features.boundaryAcceptance: Safari uses the accessible toolbar/center channel without an unsupported notifications grant; denied channels, suspension and missing evidence never create repeated prompts or guessed alerts.
features.dataSource: at most five explicitly tracked canonical targets through the shared read scheduler
features.freshnessRule: alarm revalidates account/target/source; no stale or unknown alert
features.privacy: session-first-private-data; no telemetry; redacted exports; explicit persistence only for authored personal state
features.activation: explicit user gesture selects an available platform channel, enables the selected-target subscription and requests only supported optional grants; each alarm wake revalidates current eligibility, identity, grants and shared budgets before reads or alerts
features.coexistence: omit equivalent native control; explain loaded scope; preserve native content, drafts, checks and recovery
features.accessibility: keyboard/focus, screen reader, 200% zoom/320 CSS px, themes, reduced motion; complete en/es/fr/pt

tests.scenario: After explicit supported-channel/monitor grants and target selection, a due browser alarm observes one verified tracked transition and emits one redacted attention item through that platform adapter within quiet-hour and request budgets.

Safari omits OS notifications and their permission and delivers toolbar/center attention; Chrome/Firefox denial leaves the requested mode off until an explicit local-channel choice; suspension/restart never claims exact delivery or repeats prompts.
Pausing the repository or revoking a grant before an alarm fires prevents all reads and notifications for that target.
A duplicate alarm or worker restart cannot emit the same target/revision/transition alert twice; quiet hours defer or suppress according to the chosen policy.
More due targets than the six-GET-per-wake or shared hourly budget permits are rotated/deferred without exceeding any account/repository ceiling.
Changing or losing the selected session identity clears private queued alert evidence and requires explicit reconnect before private monitoring resumes.
A stale, partial, foreign-target or unknown source never generates a success/blocker alert as though it were verified current evidence.
